decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's precision wafer capabilities and future focus on multifunctional packaging substrates, Product A should be retained because there is no clear evidence of performance below aspiration and the growing, R&D-intensive context gives enough slack to continue learning in the market.

Product B should be retained because it directly fits the firm's established carrier-wafer and thin-wafer-handling business, was explicitly launched for a concrete customer need, and there is no sign of a shortfall large enough to justify redeploying resources so soon after launch.
